label: Web Search
description: Search the web (semantic or keyword, picked per query) and get results with their page text, ready for an LLM node. Uses Exa. Each text is cut at `maxTextChars`, and the longest ones shorter still when the results would weigh more than the 100 KB a wire carries.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Exa access (wire an ExaAccess node).

inputs.name: maxTextChars
inputs.label: Text per result
inputs.description: Max page-text characters per result. `numResults` times this must be at most 102,400 (the 100 KB a wire carries), or the node refuses before searching; the default keeps ten results near 40 KB. Text in a script that takes several bytes a character (Chinese, Japanese) weighs more, and the longest texts are then cut shorter to fit. Ignored when `includeText` is off.

inputs.name: includeDomains
inputs.description: Only results from these domains. Empty = the whole web.

outputs.name: results
outputs.type: List[{ title: String | Null, url: String, publishedDate: String | Null, text: String | Null }]
outputs.description: Each result: title, url, publishedDate, text.
